Shows 25 saved items per page. Unsaved writing is still in its editor. Existing static pages without saved edits keep their original content. Newsletters created directly in Brevo are checked in Brevo.

Private recovery & backups

Every confirmed save of a story, page section or Postcard keeps a private saved version with its photo references. Open the item and use Saved versions to recover it.

Independent OneDrive backup status is being checked.

Independent snapshots are stored in your existing OneDrive project under backups/content. They include saved writing, uploaded website photos, saved versions and the private calendar. Unconfirmed browser edits are not included. You can also download a backup from each editor.

Publishing & privacy

Sign in to see which website you are managing.

  • Saving keeps a private draft. Preview and Publish on website put the reviewed version on the website.
  • Website publication and Postcard email are separate. Saving or publishing a story never sends a newsletter automatically.
  • Confirmed saves keep private recovery versions. Independent backups are stored in your existing OneDrive project.
  • Contact messages stay in your private admin inbox. Google and Authenticator remain required for owner access.
